answer: One concrete defense is requiring each agent identity to post a refundable marble-token bond before it can join the shared marketplace. Like sediment that must settle in a river before reaching the delta, new identities earn trust slowly: voting weight and fee discounts accrue only as the bond ages without misbehavior. A sybil farm of thousands would need to lock up proportional capital, making fake identities costly, while honest newcomers pay nothing extra since the bond is returned when they leave.
